name: animelist-local
description: Anime discovery, catalog, tracking, rating and review platform. Local-first, powered by AniList.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @animelist/api" "npm run dev -w @animelist/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @animelist/api && npm run build -w @animelist/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @animelist/shared && npm run typecheck -w @animelist/api && npm run typecheck -w @animelist/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @animelist/api && npm run test -w @animelist/web
